description: This file contains tests for the daemon-install-plan shared module, specifically testing functions related to resolving development modes, node binary directories, and runtime inputs.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDevMode
methods.description: Tests whether the resolveGatewayDevMode function correctly detects gateway source entry points based on file paths.

methods.name: resolveDaemonInstallRuntimeInputs
methods.description: Tests whether resolveDaemonInstallRuntimeInputs correctly preserves explicit env variables, devMode, and nodePath overrides.

methods.name: resolveDaemonNodeBinDir
methods.description: Tests whether resolveDaemonNodeBinDir correctly computes the Node.js binary directory from a given path.
